findings.passage: “In a time when voter confidence in the integrity of our elections is at an all time low, this is simple legislation to improve security for our elections and confidence from Wisconsin voters. I would like to thank President Trump for his leadership on this issue. Thank you for your attention to this matter.”
findings.note: Her own release on a bill she and seven other Assembly members began circulating to bar ballot drop boxes in Wisconsin elections. Related election-security topic, not about ID itself.
